atAGlance: Súp bí đỏ is pumpkin soup, usually with smooth pumpkin, cream or broth, and gentle sweetness.
whatItIs: Súp bí đỏ is pumpkin soup, usually smooth, lightly sweet, and creamy or velvety depending on the shop. It can be a cafe, banquet, or family-style starter.
howToEnjoy: Sip it warm and taste for sweetness before adding pepper. Bread or rice may come on the side depending on the setting.
howLocalsOrder: Order súp bí đỏ when you want a gentle pumpkin soup. Ask whether it contains cream, chicken stock, or meat if dietary needs matter.
worthKnowing: Bí đỏ means pumpkin, and the soup can range from western-influenced creamy to lighter Vietnamese-style versions.
goodToKnow: Pumpkin soup may be a modern café or family-style soup; ask if it contains cream, chicken stock, or seafood stock if needed.
